findings.en_sentence: Gilchristosuchus lived during the Santonian stage, between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago.
findings.es_sentence: Gilchristosuchus vivió durante el piso santoniense, hace entre 85,7 y 83,6 millones de años.
findings.problem: States a Santonian-only age as fact; the cited enwiki text (F002) gives latest Santonian or earliest Campanian, so the page hides that uncertainty and the PBDB range leaves out the Campanian option.
findings.correct: Its rocks date to the latest Santonian or earliest Campanian, about 84-83 million years ago.

findings.en_sentence: Gilchristosuchus belongs to the parent group Neosuchia.
findings.es_sentence: Gilchristosuchus pertenece al grupo superior Neosuchia.
findings.problem: Repeats sentence 1, which already calls it a neosuchian crocodyliform.
findings.correct: Drop it or merge it with the Eusuchia sentence.

findings.en_sentence: Researchers suggested that Gilchristosuchus was the most derived neosuchian crocodyliform that did not belong to Eusuchia, the group containing all living crocodilians.
findings.es_sentence: Los investigadores sugirieron que Gilchristosuchus era el neosuco crocodiliforme más derivado que no pertenecía a Eusuchia, el grupo que contiene a todos los cocodrilos actuales.
findings.problem: 'neosuco' is not the usual Spanish form (it is 'neosuquio'), the word order differs from sentence 1, and 'cocodrilos' is narrower than 'crocodilians'.
findings.correct: ...era el neosuquio más derivado fuera de Eusuchia, el grupo que incluye a todos los crocodilianos actuales.

findings.en_sentence: Gilchristosuchus is an extinct genus of neosuchian crocodyliform named after the ranch owners where the type specimen was discovered.
findings.es_sentence: Gilchristosuchus es un género extinto de crocodiliforme neosuco, nombrado en honor a los propietarios de la finca donde se descubrió el espécimen tipo.
findings.correct: ...un género extinto de crocodiliforme neosuquio, nombrado en honor a los Gilchrist, propietarios del rancho donde...
